seoTitle: Book an intro in Vienna | Petrina Salema
seoDescription: A free 30-minute intro, or a paid hour, with Petrina Salema in Vienna. Bring the floor plan if you have one.
hook: Your space is already deciding how you live. Stop decorating around a life you didn't choose. Shape the rooms that define how you want to rest, gather, and think.

projectOffer.title: Full project
projectOffer.body: This is a redesign of how a home or a room operates. It's about how a family or guests move through it, and then about the layout, materials, sourcing, and styling.
projectOffer.note: I take on a few residences a year. Most of them take one to three months, in person in Vienna, and remotely abroad.
projectOffer.finance: You'll get a quote after the first conversation. A deposit starts the project, and then billing goes in stages until the last invoice.

jumpstartOffer.title: Consultation
jumpstartOffer.body: In one hour, get a clear point of view on the change that would matter most adapting your rooms into a space that shapes the way you want to live.

faq.question: Who is this for?
faq.answer: This is for someone whose rooms already decide the day, and who is ready to change that. Often a home in Vienna, or a place they want guests to feel welcome in.

faq.question: Do you work in Vienna, or also remotely?
faq.answer: I work in person in Vienna, and remotely abroad. The first conversation is enough to see which of those fits.

faq.question: What do you not do?
faq.answer: I do not file licensed architectural drawings, and this is not a chamber Innenarchitekt practice. The work is furnishing concepts and the rooms around them: the plan, materials, sourcing, and styling.

faq.question: How does payment work?
faq.answer: The intro is free. The consult is €290 for the hour, paid when you book. For a full project, you'll get a quote after the first conversation. A deposit starts the work, and then billing goes in stages until the last invoice.

faq.question: What should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring the floor plan if you have one, and a few photos of the rooms as they are. If you do not have a plan yet, still come. We can start from how you want the days to go.
